title: Key with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Key shaft -->
  <rect x='38' y='48' width='44' height='12' rx='3' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <!-- Shaft highlight -->
  <rect x='38' y='48' width='44' height='4' rx='3' fill='#FFE58A'/>
  <!-- Key head (bow) -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='54' r='22' fill='#FFC53D'/>
  <!-- Inner ring -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='54' r='15' fill='#FFE58A'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='54' r='11' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on bow -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#7A4A00'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#7A4A00'/>
  <path d='M25 57 Q32 64 39 57' stroke='#7A4A00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='23' cy='56' r='2' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='56' r='2' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <!-- Key teeth -->
  <rect x='68' y='60' width='7' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#E5A800'/>
  <rect x='77' y='60' width='5' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#E5A800'/>
  <!-- Key teeth highlights -->
  <rect x='68' y='60' width='7' height='2.5' rx='1.5' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <rect x='77' y='60' width='5' height='2.5' rx='1.5' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <!-- Glow dots on shaft -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#FFE58A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#FFE58A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#FFE58A'/>
</svg>
